releaseNotes: 2,600 ready-to-use supplier dinners; 400 held supplier records remain saved but unavailable for cooking or shopping until repaired.
The home page no longer shows an intrusive warning about held recipes; historical planned dinners remain safe and replaceable in the day editor.
The shopping list estimate now has equal spacing above and below the price on phones, tablets and the web.
Imported linked recipes can use an alternate genuine image declared by the same recipe page if the first image fails.
Existing plans, favourites, account and guest data, UK and Australian supermarket pricing, and manual week generation remain protected.
